caption:
Your close rate is a dollar figure sitting in your pipeline right now.

The Revenue Calculator takes three numbers: monthly lead volume, average job value, and current close rate.

It shows the revenue gap between where you close deals today and where you'd land with faster, better follow-up.

Three inputs. No signup, no card.
